title: Braided Lady Mummy Reveals Ancient Funerary Secrets via CT Scan
description: Researchers use CT scans on the Braided Lady mummy from the University of Michigan, uncovering dental rituals and burial methods from Egypt's 18th to 21st Dynasties.

title: Polish City Turns Sewage Into Heating Energy, Cutting Reliance on Fossil Fuels
description: The Polish city of Biłgoraj has commissioned a heat pump installation that recovers thermal energy from treated wastewater and uses it to supply its municipal heating network. The project was developed by Metrolog under a design-and-build contract, with an investment exceeding 12 million Polish złoty (PLN). The system currently provides approximately 20% of the energy […]

title: Scientists build an electric motor from a single molecule; an ancient Archimedes screw inspires a machine that can reverse its rotation
description: Scientists have developed an electrically powered molecular motor inspired by the ancient Archimedes screw. The machine uses flowing electrons to rotate a single molecule, with voltage polarity controlling its direction. Published in Nature, the study also reveals that molecular rotation can increase electrical conductivity by up to 100 times. The findings could advance molecular electronics, spintronics and microfluidics, although researchers say further work is needed before practical applications become possible.

title: A fossil crocodile skull missing its snout just like the Great Sphinx finally got its own name after a century
description: A crocodile skull from the rock of the Great Sphinx was misnamed for a century. CT scans show where Herugavialis fits among the gavials.

title: Steal Their Style: 'I'm gonna cut this dress up to give it an ancient Greek aesthetic sort of vibe'
description: From budget-friendly DIY Greek gods and Hannah Montana costumes to 1960s Borsalino hats and Vinted treasures, we hit the streets of Manchester to find out what people are wearing—and who they're dressing up as this Halloween.
